title: groundtruth snapshot manifest, version manifest/1
description: What one snapshot holds and how it was made: one collection, one region, one UTC day. data/SCHEMA.md says what each field means. validate.mjs adds the checks JSON Schema can't say: the snapshot id agrees with its parts, the record count agrees with the files, a count gap is explained, and the listed files hash to what the manifest says.

rule.description: point-in-bbox: a Point record is in when it lies inside the box, edges included. intersects-bbox: any geometry that touches the box. point-in-polygon: a Point record is in when it lies inside a named boundary polygon, which definition names (source, fetch and sha256); bbox is then the polygon's extent.

requests.description: Every request the builder made, in order.

purpose.description: records: the rows the snapshot holds. count: the publisher's count. gap: the publisher's ids, to explain a count gap. region: the boundary the region rule tests against.

publisherCount.description: The publisher's own count for the region, and how it was asked for. gap is required when value differs from recordCount.

gapItems.description: The publisher rows that are not records, one entry per publisher id, each with the reason, beside the prose gap. With gapItems present, value must equal recordCount + gapItems.length + duplicateRows (validate.mjs, code gap). Optional in manifest/1 (added 2026-10-20); the 2026-10-19 manifests carry the prose gap only and still pass.

duplicateRows.description: Publisher rows that repeat an id another row already has (a record's key is its id, so one record per id): the number of extra rows. Counted in the gapItems arithmetic. Absent means 0.

format.description: jsonl: one record/1 object per line, checked line by line. geoparquet: GeoParquet written by data/pipeline, checked by bytes and sha256 here and by row count in data/pipeline/read.py.

withheldFields.description: Source fields eye shows that this snapshot leaves out, and why. Absent when none are withheld.

joins.description: How each joined field was filled, per field, so a trainer can filter on it and a gap is never silent. One entry per joined field (today place.countyFips). placed + unplaced.length must equal recordCount (validate.mjs, code joins). Reasons for an unplaced record live here, never on the record. Optional in manifest/1 (added 2026-10-20); the 2026-10-19 manifests carry none and still pass.

boundary.description: The boundary file the polygons came from: publisher, product, vintage, the URL it was downloaded from, the sha256 of the downloaded bytes and when.

methods.description: How many records got the field by each place.method. Their sum is placed.

crossCheck.description: A second, independent join compared with the polygon: the publisher's own county on the row. agree + disagree + unchecked counts the records; unchecked is a record with no polygon answer or no publisher county the rule could read. disagree equals disagreements.length.

disagreements.description: Where the polygon and the publisher's county differ. pip is the county the polygon says (the record keeps it); name is the county the publisher's string (or NCES's code) says.

embeddableFields.description: The details keys eye agrees to embed for this collection, derived by data/schema/embeddable.mjs from eye's EMBED_TEXT (apps/map/lib/catalog/embedFields.ts), never written by hand; validate.mjs fails when it differs. Consumer rule: embed or train on a record's text, these details keys, and its name only as embeddableName allows. Every other details key is for display and citation. Optional in manifest/1 (added 2026-10-19); every committed snapshot carries it.

embeddableName.description: When a record's name may be embedded, derived from eye's PUBLIC_NAME_RULE: when-nameRule-public-name (only a record whose nameRule is public-name; a label-by-id name never) or never. Present exactly when embeddableFields is.
